id: 2667
slug: create-hello-world-function
title: Create Hello World Function
difficulty: easy
signature: string helloWorld()
---
Write a function that takes no arguments and returns the text `Hello World`.

The answer must match exactly: a capital `H`, a capital `W` and a single space
between the words. See [the format notes](https://example.com/notes) for how
strings are compared.
